{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed_mask = (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')

# Extract revenue for completed orders from loyal customers
revenue_loyal_completed = sales_df.loc[loyal_completed_mask, 'revenue']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = revenue_loyal_completed.mean()

# Print the precise mean value
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}")

# Also print the rounded value for reporting
print(f"Rounded mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
